initial_state: Same saved accepted poses and incoming priors from assets/depth-convergence-v1/summary.json
data_role: already viewed development; bounded local refinement only
association: Re-select reciprocal pixel pairs at each batch start; keep them fixed within at most3 corrections; re-check fresh geometry at every batch end
relinearization: Unchanged fixed-refinement residual, normal rotation derivative, Huber weights and nonlinear incoming-prior transport
guards: Original support>=200 per raw pair, scaled SPD/condition<=1e6, full node increments<=0.1m/0.15rad; no rank fill
step: Eight Armijo lengths1..1/128 against current batch frozen Huber-plus-prior objective
convergence: Only fresh-population full proposals below strict1e-5m/1e-5rad for every nonorigin node
fixed_convergence: May end an inner batch but cannot terminate the global solver without fresh convergence
stop: Fresh convergence, reproduced guard failure/no progress, or ten total applied corrections
control: Archived ten fresh-association continuation corrections from exactly the same initial poses/prior; equal maximum applied corrections, not a runtime comparison
progression_rule: Advance only if BOTH cases improve fresh-converged count with no guards, all fresh RMS<=0.03m, and median fresh RMS no worse than control
